title: 高三短对话：接送与展厅
source_notice: 高三公开期末标签的五短对话两遍/十秒和已解示例已核；原音轨缺，印本注释脚本/键可核，原校地域学期正文未认证，“上学期2月”标题疑点保留。本稿完整原创配套非来源gold或独立难度验证。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听后留10秒。另有一个已解示例，示例录音在材料1开头，示范一次属本机编排，不计入五题。本机可重播供审阅，不作正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Can you collect me at the gallery at five twenty?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I have a meeting until five thirty. Give me twenty minutes to drive there.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: All right. I will wait by the side entrance.

questions.stem: When will the man collect the woman?
questions.rationale: A：最初要求未能实现；B：会议结束非到达；C：5:30加20分钟

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You have sketched several versions of that entrance.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The client wants more daylight without losing the original brickwork. I will discuss these plans with the structural engineer before presenting them.

questions.stem: What is the woman most likely to be?
questions.rationale: A：有客户和结构工程协作非普通参观；B：入口设计与结构工程师支持建筑师；C：无接待入住

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The course costs six hundred pounds, but you only pay one third when you book. The rest is due when it starts.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Fine. I will make the booking payment today.

questions.stem: How much will the man pay today?
questions.rationale: A：600的三分之一200；B：是其余款项；C：非今天全额

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We had enough food and the weather was fine, so I expected to reach the summit.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: One member twisted her ankle. Carrying on would have put her at risk, so the whole team returned together.

questions.stem: Why did the team turn back?
questions.rationale: A：食物充足；B：天气好；C：队员扭伤使全队返回

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I read novels on my tablet because I can enlarge the text.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That would be useful, but I still prefer a paper book. I like leaving it open on the table without a battery running down.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.rationale: A：没有作者名字；B：平板和纸书各自偏好；C：没有讨论价格

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Is this cap six pounds fifty?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That was the old price. It is eight pounds fifty now.

question.stem: How much does the cap cost?
question.rationale: A：旧价不是现价；B：没有十五便士；C：现价八镑五十
